label: Renewable energy
description: Generation, equipment and services for renewable electricity, heat and fuels.
include: Solar PV and CSP, onshore and offshore wind, hydropower, geothermal, ocean energy, sustainable bioenergy (biomass, biogas and biofuels from waste or residues); manufacture, installation, operation and maintenance of their equipment; sale of renewable electricity, heat or fuels.
exclude: Fossil gas (transition row only); nuclear power (not green in this table: recorded and flagged in the transition row); peat; bioenergy from food or feed crops or with high indirect land-use-change risk; hydropower below 5 W/m2 power density or above 100 gCO2e/kWh lifecycle emissions.

label: Energy efficiency
description: Products, services and installations that cut energy use per unit of output.
include: Heat pumps; high-efficiency motors, drives, lighting (LED) and HVAC; building and industrial energy-management systems and controls; efficiency retrofits and energy-service (ESCO) contracts; district heating and cooling from renewable or waste heat.
exclude: Efficiency upgrades of fossil-fuel generation, extraction or processing assets (transition row); fossil-fuel boilers and furnaces, even high-efficiency ones; product improvements without a disclosed energy-saving basis; nuclear (flagged in the transition row).

label: Clean transport
description: Zero-direct-emission vehicles, rail and the infrastructure they need.
include: Battery-electric and fuel-cell vehicles and their components (batteries, e-drives); electrified rail, metro and tram and their rolling stock; charging and hydrogen-refuelling infrastructure; e-bikes, cycling and public-transport infrastructure; zero-direct-emission vessels and aircraft.
exclude: Internal-combustion vehicles including plug-in and mild hybrids (transition row); LNG or CNG vehicles and vessels (transition row); efficiency gains on fossil-fuelled fleets (transition row); infrastructure dedicated to transporting fossil fuels; nuclear (flagged in the transition row).

label: Green buildings
description: Construction, renovation, acquisition and ownership of low-energy buildings.
include: New buildings with primary energy demand at least 10% below the nearly-zero-energy standard or certified at top tiers (LEED Platinum or Gold, BREEAM Excellent or Outstanding, DGNB Gold or Platinum, Energy Star 85 or more); major renovations cutting primary energy demand by at least 30%; buildings with an EPC class A.
exclude: Buildings whose only green attribute is a lower-tier certificate; buildings dedicated to extracting, storing or transporting fossil fuels; efficiency equipment sold on its own (energy_efficiency); nuclear (flagged in the transition row).

label: Grids and storage
description: Electricity transmission and distribution, grid digitalisation and energy storage.
include: Transmission and distribution lines, substations and interconnectors on grids that meet a decarbonisation pathway or connect renewables; smart meters and grid digitalisation; battery, pumped-hydro, thermal and other energy storage.
exclude: Direct connections to fossil-fuel plants; fossil gas grids and storage (transition row only if converted for hydrogen or blending); nuclear (flagged in the transition row).

label: Hydrogen
description: Production, transport, storage and use equipment for low-carbon hydrogen and its derivatives.
include: Electrolytic hydrogen from renewable electricity with lifecycle emissions below 3 tCO2e per tonne of hydrogen; electrolysers and fuel cells; hydrogen pipelines, storage and refuelling; green ammonia and e-fuels made from it.
exclude: Grey hydrogen from unabated fossil gas; blue hydrogen from fossil gas with CCS (transition row); hydrogen from nuclear electricity (flagged in the transition row).

label: Carbon capture, use and storage
description: Capture, transport, permanent storage and long-lived use of CO2, and carbon removal.
include: Direct air capture; bioenergy with carbon capture and storage; capture equipment, CO2 transport and permanent geological storage; CO2 use in long-lived products such as mineralised building materials.
exclude: CO2 for enhanced oil recovery; capture at fossil-fuel power plants or upstream oil and gas assets (transition row); trading in carbon credits or offsets without own capture; nuclear (flagged in the transition row).

label: Low-carbon materials and products
description: Materials and products made with substantially lower lifecycle emissions than the sector benchmark.
include: Steel, cement, aluminium, chemicals and plastics produced below the EU Taxonomy threshold or a disclosed science-based benchmark (for example hydrogen-DRI steel, low-clinker cement); bio-based materials from sustainable sources; components whose main purpose is a low-carbon technology (wind blades, battery materials) when not counted in another category.
exclude: Incremental reductions on conventional production without a stated benchmark; products marketed as low-carbon without a disclosed basis; materials for fossil-fuel extraction; nuclear (flagged in the transition row).

label: Circular economy
description: Recycling, reuse, repair, remanufacturing and turning waste into resources.
include: Material recovery and recycling; remanufacturing, refurbishment, repair and product-as-a-service models; sale of secondary raw materials; separate waste collection; anaerobic digestion and composting of bio-waste.
exclude: Waste incineration, including with energy recovery; landfill; downcycling sold as recycling without a disclosed recovery rate; nuclear (flagged in the transition row).

label: Water and pollution control
description: Water supply, wastewater treatment and the prevention and control of pollution.
include: Water supply and wastewater treatment that meet an efficiency or quality improvement; water reuse and renewable-powered desalination; leak reduction; air, soil and water pollution-control equipment; remediation of contaminated sites; nature-based flood and drought protection.
exclude: Pollution control that is a legal minimum on fossil-fuel plants (for example flue-gas desulphurisation at coal plants); fossil-powered desalination; water services to fossil-fuel extraction such as fracking water; nuclear (flagged in the transition row).

label: Transition (not green)
description: Activities that cut emissions against a fossil baseline but are not green; reported separately and never added to the green total.
include: Fossil gas only as a defined transition case: gas-fired power, heat or CHP below 270 gCO2e/kWh lifecycle emissions or replacing coal, and gas infrastructure converted for hydrogen or blending, per the EU Complementary Delegated Act criteria or the company's stated equivalent; blue hydrogen; CCS on fossil-fuel assets; plug-in and mild hybrid vehicles; LNG and CNG transport; efficiency upgrades of fossil-fuel assets; nuclear power and nuclear-derived hydrogen, recorded here and flagged separately (the quote must name nuclear).
exclude: Coal, oil and unabated fossil gas without a decarbonisation pathway; any amount already counted in a green category; carbon credits and offsets.
